name: Covert Ops Pack
summary: In Stonetalon, the Covert Ops Pack equips Alliance agents to sabotage Venture Company sites and steal their plans. Its charges and schematics target the company’s work in Windshear Crag.

sections.title: Sabotage by Design
sections.body: The Covert Ops Pack carries charges and plans for strikes inside Venture Company territory. Red and blue NG-5 explosives pair with remote detonators, while Plan Alpha and Plan Beta give agents instructions. The explosives target the Cragpool Lake lumber mill and the eastern mine. As goblins rush to fight fires and inspect broken machinery, an infiltrator can slip through the confusion and take documents and schematics.

sections.title: A Confluence of Interests
sections.body: The pack serves both the night elf Sentinels and Alliance engineers in Stonetalon. Its blasts and theft hinder the clear-cutting and excavation of the sacred mountainside. The stolen Venture Company engineering plans also offer insight into goblin heavy machinery. They show where the machines can fail and give Alliance engineers ideas to adapt for their own designs.

faq.q: What is inside the Covert Ops Pack?
faq.answer: The Covert Ops Pack holds red and blue NG-5 explosives with matching remote detonators, along with written instructions for Plan Alpha and Plan Beta.

faq.q: What is the tactical purpose of the explosives?
faq.answer: The explosives make loud distractions at Venture Company work sites. With security drawn away, an operative can enter the lumber mill and mine unseen.

faq.q: What intelligence does this operation target?
faq.answer: The operation seeks Venture Company engineering plans from the lumber mill south of Cragpool Lake, then executive letters kept in Windshear Mine at the crag’s eastern end.

faq.q: Who benefits from the materials recovered using this pack?
faq.answer: The night elf Sentinels and Alliance engineers both benefit. The sabotage hinders deforestation, while engineers study the schematics to find weaknesses in Venture Company shredders and adapt ideas for their own technology.

angles.text: For an engineer, the pack turns gnomish ingenuity against goblin industry. Its customized NG-5 charges help uncover the workings of Venture Company machinery.
As an Alliance member, you support the Sentinels’ struggle against commercial despoilment in the Stonetalon Mountains.
